description: The plot illustrates the ROUGE-1 metric values for different model configurations as a function of log r. The x-axis is labeled “log r” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 8, with tick labels at integer values. The y-axis is labeled “ROUGE-1” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 35, with tick labels at intervals of 5. A red line, marked with circular data points, represents “T5 + LoRA”, beginning at approximately 24 at log r = 0, increasing up to approximately 31 at log r = 2, then decreasing to approximately 27 at log r = 8. A dark blue line, marked with circular data points, represents “MBart + LoRA”, starting at approximately 12 at log r = 0, rising sharply to approximately 28 at log r = 2, then maintaining a relatively steady value around 25 to 27 between log r = 4 and log r = 8. A green line, marked with circular data points, represents “T5 + AdaLoRA”, starting at approximately 26 at log r = 0, increasing to approximately 33 at log r = 4, and remaining at approximately 33 to 34 from log r = 4 to log r = 8. An orange line, marked with circular data points, represents “MBart + AdaLoRA”, beginning at approximately 12 at log r = 0, decreasing to approximately 5 at log r = 2, then increasing to approximately 31 at log r = 8.
